invariants.name: invariant_P1_bufferConservation
invariants.description: NEW _distributeBuffer: delta(setAsideBufferRecipient) == SUM_i floor(U * bufferShares_i / totalShares) exactly; delta(sink) + delta(skim recipient) == swap output U; skimSurplus return value == delta(skim recipient) (reduced by totalSetAside); rounding dust goes to the skim recipient

invariants.name: invariant_P1_clientsUntouchedBySkim
invariants.description: Buffer distribution never changes any client principal or client token balance

invariants.name: invariant_P2_loudGuard
invariants.description: skimSurplus with totalBufferShares > 0 and setAsideBufferRecipient unset NEVER succeeds (loud guard completeness)

invariants.name: invariant_P2_guardAtomicity
invariants.description: Any skimSurplus revert (incl. the loud guard, which sits after the swap) moves NO funds: sink, recipient, AMM, strategy underlying and strategy shares all unchanged

invariants.name: invariant_P3_statusValid
invariants.description: Withdrawal status enum always in {None, Initiated, Executable, Expired}

invariants.name: invariant_P3_liveness
invariants.description: totalWithdrawal in effective-Executable state with principal and share backing never reverts (no permanently stuck withdrawal under 6h/72h constants)

invariants.name: invariant_P3_PATTERN001_announcedAmountFaithful
invariants.description: DETECTOR: Phase-2 execution must not sweep more principal than Phase-1 announced. Fails by design of _totalWithdraw (sweeps CURRENT clientBalances, not the cached announced balance) - deposits made during the 6h waiting window get swept

invariants.name: invariant_P4_principalLedger
invariants.description: sum(principalOf[clients]) == getTotalDeposited == externally-mirrored ghost ledger, across deposit/withdraw/relinquish/skim/totalWithdrawal

invariants.name: invariant_noStuckUnderlying
invariants.description: Strategy never holds underlying at rest after any operation (deposit, withdraw, skim fast/buffered path, totalWithdrawal)
